analysis: The change is documentation only: docs/reference/configuration.md gains two rows (head lines 400-401) for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY. Both are default-on, disabled only by 0/false/no/off, read in libs/mlx-swift-lm MTPContractsV2.swift, and not forwarded to LaunchAgents. The change adds no code, endpoint, trust-boundary or credential change. The documented knobs are tuning/rollback switches for Qwen inline-MTP scheduling (ordinary chainable decode and prefill hidden carry) and do not touch coordinator-provider encryption, attestation, App Attest authorization (TB-011) or prefix-cache storage (T-041). Because they are not forwarded to LaunchAgents, they cannot be injected into the installed daemon through the plist passthrough, which keeps the existing environment-allowlist posture. The entries follow the nearby documented pattern of Nemotron MTP flags. Unverified: the underlying Swift implementation (the carry/chained decode paths) is not in this batch. The next pass should check that the default-on carry of the final prompt row's hidden state does not cross request or tenant boundaries, and that it interacts correctly with prefix-cache restore, cancellation and KV residue (T-028, T-041). Nothing in the supplied evidence shows a regression.
